Validate, diff, and export DESIGN.md files to ensure consistent design tokens, WCAG compliance, and design system integrity across projects.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the DESIGN.md Skill for design system validation and management.
- Provides linting to validate DESIGN.md files, catching broken references, WCAG contrast issues, missing primary colors, and section order warnings.
- Supports diffing between DESIGN.md file versions to detect token changes and regressions.
- Enables exporting tokens to formats like Tailwind and DTCG for use in development workflows.
- Includes commands for viewing the DESIGN.md format specification and linting rules.
- Offers integration guidance for UI development workflows.
